existing_browser.scope: Two actual rendered chart screenshots/DOM captures314.615s apart. Not a video or proof of every intermediate browser render. Earlier09:05/09:07 captures precede this visible-chart interval.

overlapping_server.scope: API/WS sampling only; these are not browser render frames.

assessment.existing_supported: At least five minutes of sampled genuine market activity and two actual chart renders over a314.615s span are supported. This is materially more than only API evidence.
assessment.remaining_gap: No saved interior screenshot/DOM capture within the visible-chart interval, and book rows are below the viewport in both endpoints. Therefore sustained five-minute rendering of chart+depth+trade display as one browser observation remains weak.
assessment.docs_ui: Correctly limits the separate08:35 API/WS observation; it does not currently link the later visible-chart pair in that paragraph.
assessment.docs_verification: Its cited314.615s chart update exists and matches raw artifacts. Do not expand the row into uninterrupted rendering/every-frame assurance; describe sampled screen evidence and strengthen it.

minimal_followup_plan.services: Use existing standalone http://127.0.0.1:5175 and running engine/bots. No restart, new fixture, manual trades, extra load or currentdata modification.
minimal_followup_plan.start: Use one actual desktop tab, fixed viewport/scroll with chart and depth values visible. Record URL, tab identity, source/build hashes, real start UTC, event seq, cumulative volume, latest trade and current connection/gap count. Keep UI source unchanged through the window.
minimal_followup_plan.cadence: Observe for at least315s actual wall time. Save read-only DOM state every15-30s, plus raw screenshots near0/60/120/180/240/315s. Record exact capture timestamps; do not infer duration from scheduled sleeps.
fields: last trade timestamp/price/quantity and recent trade rows
best bid/ask price+quantity or depth row signature
chart last-trade timestamp and price-line/volume-bar rendered signature
minimal_followup_plan.check: Across at least300s, consecutive recorded observations show new real trades, changing depth signatures and advancing chart trade time/shape; document any stall/reconnect/HMR separately. Pair screen fields with nearby existing observer rows if useful, without replacing screen evidence with server samples.
minimal_followup_plan.finish: Save end screenshot/DOM, console issues, exact elapsed duration and compact per-observation table in a new run. Claim sampled browser rendering over the measured period, not all display frames or a new six-hour result.
